profiles.source: PM-resolved react/react-dom roles whose canonical target is preact/compat

priority: PM-resolved package role and alias provenance

pragma.effect: narrows this file to preact-native, including inside a React package, only with an admitted resolved Preact release

switches.auto: PM-resolved package and file evidence only; otherwise inactive
switches.on: requires an admitted exact release; without a manifest use explicit release provenance; never bypass version admission

optionalSignals.absent: no signal binding or semantic facts
optionalSignals.unsupported: no signal facts; report the separately unsupported package
optionalSignals.present: facts only for admitted resolved signals and a compatible admitted Preact release

routing.aliasEdit: invalidate affected package/file identities only; fresh equals incremental
